tool.name: check_disk_space
tool.description: Check disk space usage for a specific path or all mounted filesystems.

when_to_use.trigger: User asks about disk space or storage usage
User asks if a filesystem is full or running low
User wants to see available space on a drive
Troubleshooting "no space left on device" errors

parameters.param: Path to check (e.g., '/', '/home', '/var'). Leave empty to check all mounted filesystems.

safety_rules.rule: This is a read-only tool - always safe to execute

example.input: How much disk space do I have?

tool.output_format: For specific path: { path, total_gb, used_gb, free_gb, percent_used } For all filesystems: { filesystems: [{ mount, size, used, available, percent }] }
